title: On Bended Knee
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hibiki is the bodyguard and childhood friend of Wu Xiong (Buyu), heir to a Hong Kong business family, who would rather enjoy the nightlife than heed warnings that his uncle plans to have him killed (801 Media blurb, MU). Hibiki must decide whether his duty outweighs his feelings. A one-volume collection that also includes short stories such as two doctors in a workplace romance; MU lists the genres Adult and Smut.
life_message: Loyalty that protects someone at personal cost can become love.
